description: Read-only list of an existing PDF's AcroForm fields: fully-qualified name, type (text | checkbox | radio | dropdown | listbox | button | signature | unknown), value, flags (readOnly / required / multiline), options, widget placements. Call it BEFORE fill_form to learn the names. Encrypted sources: `password`. Token-frugal: verbosity:'summary' → { fieldCount }.

fields.description: Optional dot-path projection applied to the structured result (e.g. ['fields.name','fields.type']). Composes after verbosity. Unknown paths are omitted.

password.description: Password (user or owner) of an encrypted source. Never logged or echoed.

pdfBase64.description: Base64-encoded PDF bytes whose AcroForm fields should be enumerated.

verbosity.description: Response verbosity. 'full' (default) returns the fields[] array; 'summary' returns a token-frugal { fieldCount } and drops the array.

name: read_form_fields

outputSchema.description: Structured AcroForm field listing. Every property is optional because the result can be projected: verbosity:'summary' returns only the scalar summary fields, fields:[...] keeps a dot-path subset. Defaults return the full shape.

name.description: Fully-qualified field name (/T chain joined with ".").

onState.description: On-state name for a checkbox/radio widget (from /AP /N).

options.description: Choice options (/Opt) as { export, label }. Present for dropdown/listbox.

value.description: Current /V value: text/choice string(s), checkbox/radio state, or null.

widgets.description: Widget placements: 0-based page index and rectangle [x1,y1,x2,y2].

title: Read AcroForm fields
